title: eludite.editor.hover output
description: The Quick Info tooltip. From the UI thread this is the state right after the request was sent; from another thread the call waits up to 5 s for the answer.

state.description: `loading`, `open` (the tooltip is shown) or `closed` (nothing to show).

text.description: The tooltip's text as shown: the hover Markdown rendered as plain text, paragraphs separated by blank lines.
